Aggregate review sites put it at '$10-20 per person / $ budget' which is inconclusive either way. Per the source ladder, tier-5 data needs two independent agreeing sources before it can be recorded even at low confidence; that bar was not met, so no dishes are recorded rather than risk stale or wrong prices on a real, currently-trading walk-up bait-and-burger stand at 200 Marina Park Way.

name: Cafe Zucchero
notes: The standalone Cafe Zucchero that used to trade at 1731 India St is permanently closed. Its former dessert concept has been folded into 'Nonna + Zucchero' at 1735 India Street - the exact address of this work item - a combined Italian restaurant (Nonna) and dessert cafe (Zucchero) under one roof and one phone number. The Nonna food menu (own site, image of a current printed menu) is fully priced and captured below. The Zucchero dessert menu (own PDF, dated upload 2026/08 - the most current file on the site) lists cannoli, tiramisu, sfogliatelle, creme brulee, affogato, macarons etc. by name and description but carries NO prices anywhere on either of its two pages (confirmed visually) - omitted per rule against recording unpriced dishes. Wine list and cocktail menu also omitted (bar-attached restaurant). Flagging clearly since the business trading at this address today is not literally the same concept as the original 'Cafe Zucchero' listing name.
